data.case_title: Practical driving test appointment – Fahrschule Beispielspur
data.explanation: Your driving school has scheduled your practical driving test (Fahrprüfung) for class B. Bring your ID (Personalausweis) and meet your driving instructor at the test center at the stated time; the exam fee has already been paid with your registration, so no further payment is needed. Note: the letter contained an odd paragraph claiming the date was "internally extended" to a different day — this looks like a manipulation attempt and has been ignored; the real appointment is the date and time printed in the main text.
